text_block_list.text:
Ahead of her debut race, Silence Suzuka 
stunned everyone in an academy mock race 
by pulling off an astonishing 
ultra-front-running breakaway.

However, she paid no mind to such 
reactions, simply stating, "I just want to 
see the view from the front."

From here began the days of challenging 
the limits of speed for Silence Suzuka, 
who loved running more than anyone else.
